**voice:** each microphone now keeps its own voiceprint, and Always switches to the right one when you change mic. Before, a voiceprint recorded on one mic rejected you on another (a studio mic vs the MacBook's built-in mic), so everything you said was silently dropped. When the live mic has no voiceprint yet, the menu bar says "My Voice not set up for <mic> — Record" instead of staying silent. An existing voiceprint is kept and claimed by the mic it keeps recognising you on.
